title: 3.3.0 Beta 1 AAPS Sync/Websockets
symptom: When websockets are enabled, AAPS Client does not receive data. If websockets are disabled on all devices, sync works. Also, the 'Synchronisierung' menu in AAPS Client cannot be opened.
fix: Disable websockets on AAPS Client devices while keeping them enabled on the master device.
evidence_quote: Update: Lösung zu 1. Master - Websockets AN, AAPS Client - Websockets AUS
